name: Dimension Core: Amethyst
description:
About This Game

Dimension Core: Amethyst is a Roguelite strategy tower defense game.

In every run, you'll face completely random challenges: randomly generated maps, along with random towers, upgrades, and events. No two runs are the same.

You take direct control of your character, fighting alongside your towers. On the battlefield, your positioning, shooting, and actions matter—clearing gaps, focusing down elites, and handling emergencies, all while coordinating with your auto-attacking towers.

Resource management is key to victory. Mine minerals within the dimension and allocate them wisely between tower deployment, character upgrades, and event choices. Every decision shapes the course of the battle.

Death is not the end. Each failure accumulates progress, unlocking new towers and gameplay content, allowing you to go further on your next attempt.

Random maps, random towers, random upgrades, random events—coordinate your forces, manage your resources, build your unique combat system in an amethyst-themed dimension, and defend the Dimension Core.

Contact: rv7dev@outlook.com
